subject: Invoice authority, delivery channel and VAT evidence — next steps
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@edgescale.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@edgescale.com
Date: 2025-08-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice origination & delivery for EdgeScale

Hi Hannah,

Quick intro — I'm Marta in EdgeScale AP. We're finalizing our vendor onboarding and need to lock down two things for Redwood:

1) Who will create the legal invoice documents? (EdgeScale accounting system prefers vendors to generate invoices so our AP workflow can reconcile by invoice number, but we can also accept vendor-originated invoices delivered to our SFTP.)
2) Delivery method: preferred is SFTP drop (UBL/XML) to our collector, with a cc to accounts@edgescale.com. Fallback to emailed PDF copies is acceptable for the first 2 months.
3) VAT evidence: for EU reverse-charge we need supplier VAT number, invoice language note, and a copy of VAT registration if available.

I've attached a UBL sample and the PO (PO-ES-9421). Can you confirm whether Redwood will be the invoice originator or if EdgeScale should pull invoices via API? Also share the billing contact and who signs off on invoice authority (is a DocuSign OK?).

Thanks — Marta
Marta Alvarez
Head of Accounts Payable
EdgeScale
attachments: EdgeScale-UBL-sample.xml (UBL sample), PO-ES-9421.pdf (PO)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@edgescale.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origination & delivery for EdgeScale

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear ask and the samples. Short answers up front:

- Redwood can be the invoice originator (we can generate legal invoices).
- We can deliver UBL/XML over SFTP into your collector and copy accounts@edgescale.com.
- We can include the VAT registration number and the reverse-charge/legal note on the invoice.

A couple of clarifying questions before we finalize the handoff:
- Can you confirm the SFTP host, preferred filename pattern (you included a UBL sample), and whether consumption of our billing timezone (UTC) is acceptable?
- Do you require invoices to contain your PO number in the invoice header or as a line-level reference?
- For the DocuSign: who is the EdgeScale approver (name, title, and email) to sign the invoice authority agreement?

I'll loop Connor (AP integrations) to outline the technical steps (SFTP keys/format/fallback) and Kim to own the billing contact record. Proposed next step: we send a one-page "Invoice Authority & Delivery" DocuSign and a sample invoice from our system for you to validate.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Alvarez <marta@edgescale.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@edgescale.com
Date: 2025-08-03T07:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origination & delivery for EdgeScale

Thanks Hannah — answers below:

- SFTP host: sftp.edgescale-collector.com (we'll provide an account). Filename: ES_INV_YYYYMMDD_INVNO.xml.
- Please place PO number in the invoice header (field: buyerReference).
- Signer for DocuSign: Marta Alvarez (Head of AP) — marta@edgescale.com.
- VAT: EdgeScale is in Spain — please include our VAT number ESB12345678 on the invoice and attach a scanned VAT cert if you have one.

We prefer vendor-originated invoices (Redwood creates them) because our system reconciles against vendor invoice numbers and UBL identifiers. The SFTP drop with a copy to accounts@edgescale.com is ideal. Fallback to emailed PDF is fine for the onboarding window (we'll rely on PDFs only if your SFTP transfer is delayed).

Attaching the PO again for clarity. Let me know the expected cadence (monthly in arrears) and whether you need remittance instructions.

Marta
attachments: PO-ES-9421.pdf

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@edgescale.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-04T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origination & delivery for EdgeScale

Hi Marta / Hannah — Connor here on integrations. A few technical notes and the proposed delivery plan:

Planned flow (if vendor-originated invoices):
- Redwood will generate UBL/XML per your sample, filename pattern ES_INV_YYYYMMDD_INVNO.xml.
- We'll push files to sftp.edgescale-collector.com using an account we'll provision and public-key auth.
- We'll also send an email notification to accounts@edgescale.com with a PDF copy for human review (subject line: Redwood invoice INV-XXXXX for PO ES-9421).

Fallbacks and SLAs:
- If SFTP transfer fails we will retry for up to 24 hours and then email a PDF to accounts@edgescale.com and to your procurement address.
- We'll include our VAT (GB123456789) and a reverse-charge note ("VAT reverse charge — recipient liable") on EU invoices where applicable. Please confirm if you prefer the note in English or Spanish.

Data retention & evidence:
- We can attach a scanned VAT certificate as an additional element in UBL extension or a separate PDF on the SFTP. Let us know which you prefer.

Next steps for keys/credentials:
1) EdgeScale creates an SFTP account and sends the public key.
2) We run a one-file test and exchange checksum.
3) Sign DocuSign for invoice authority and billing contact.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through a sample transfer this week.

Connor Obrien
Product Ops — Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@edgescale.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-04T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origination & delivery for EdgeScale

Ack — Kim here and I'll be the billing contact once we've completed DocuSign. A couple quick asks:
- Can EdgeScale confirm retention requirement for invoice PDFs (EdgeScale retention policy window)? We keep copies for 7 years by default but can adjust exports.
- If you require the VAT cert as a persistent file in SFTP, note that creates a small compliance checklist for our side (we'll need a signed attestation).

I'll prepare the sample invoice (PDF + UBL) after we get the SFTP public key.

Kimberly Park
Senior Billing Lead
Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@edgescale.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-05T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice authority, delivery channel and VAT evidence — next steps

Thanks all — summarizing and proposed timeline:

1) EdgeScale to provision SFTP account and reply with the public SSH key by EOD 2025-08-07.
2) Redwood will generate vendor-originated invoices monthly in arrears and push UBL/XML + PDF to the SFTP. Filename: ES_INV_YYYYMMDD_INVNO.xml and ES_INV_YYYYMMDD_INVNO.pdf.
3) We'll include PO in buyerReference and EdgeScale VAT ESB12345678 on every EU invoice. Reverse-charge note language: English ("VAT reverse charge — recipient liable") as discussed.
4) DocuSign: I'll send the invoice authority + billing contact confirmation doc to Marta for signature by 2025-08-10.
5) Test: one test invoice transfer the week of 2025-08-11; production go-live target 2025-09-01.

Attachments we will send with the DocuSign: sample Redwood invoice (redwood-invoice-sample-2025-07.pdf), the UBL sample, and the transfer checklist.

If EdgeScale needs remittance details earlier, Kim can provide. Otherwise we'll wait for the public key and sign-off.

Best,
Hannah
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
